description: This file defines the CalendarCacheEventService class, which manages calendar event caching, including handling events, cleaning cache, and checking supported calendar types.

classes.name: CalendarCacheEventService
classes.description: Service to handle calendar cache, including event processing and cache maintenance.

methods.name: handleEvents
methods.description: Processes calendar subscription events, updating the cache with new or removed events.

methods.name: cleanupCache
methods.description: Removes all events associated with a specific calendar from the cache.

methods.name: cleanupStaleCache
methods.description: Removes stale events from the cache.

methods.name: isCalendarTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given calendar type is supported by the application.
